from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAssets(BaseModel):
    """Fixed assets data for one company as reported in their financial document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    fixed_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Fixed assets balance as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fixed_assets: list[CompanyFixedAssets]
